<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width">
    <title></title>
    <style>
        .mydiv {
            max-width: 500px;
            overflow-wrap: break-word;
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <div>ZPL CODE</div>
    <textarea id="tcode" cols="30" rows="20" style="width: 500px; height: 200px; font-family: monospace;">
    </textarea>
    <br>
    <textarea id="myconsole" cols="30" rows="20" style="width: 500px; height: 200px; font-family: monospace;">
    </textarea>
    <button style="width: 300px; height: 50px;" onclick="testcode();">PRINT</button>
    <hr>
    <div id="myresult"></div>

    <hr>
    <canvas id="mycanv" width="768" height="500"></canvas>
    <hr>
    <img src="" id="myimg">

    <hr>

    <script>
        var UUID = workflowObject.UUID;
        var AccountExternalID =  workflowObject.AccountExternalID;
        var AccountTSABalance = workflowObject["AccountTSABalance"];
        var UPC = workflowObject["ItemUPC"];
        var WrntyID = workflowObject["WrntyID"];
        var ActionDateTime = workflowObject["ActionDateTime"];
        var AgentName = workflowObject["AgentName"];
        var Remark = workflowObject["Remark"];
        var AccountName = workflowObject["AccountName"];
        var TSATotalItems = workflowObject["QuantitiesTotal"];
        var SubTotal = workflowObject["SubTotal"];
        var TSATotalDiscount = 0;
        var GrandTotal = workflowObject["GrandTotal"];
        var QuantitiesTotal = workflowObject["QuantitiesTotal"];

        var Currency = workflowObject["Currency"];

        var UnitPrice = workflowObject["UnitPrice"];

        var BillToCity = workflowObject["BillToCity"];
        var BillToCountry = workflowObject["BillToCountry"];
        var BillToName = workflowObject["BillToName"];
        var BillToPhone = workflowObject["BillToPhone"];
        var BillToState = workflowObject["BillToState"];
        var BillToStreet = workflowObject["BillToStreet"];
        var BillToZipCode = workflowObject["BillToZipCode"];

        var ShipToCity = workflowObject["ShipToCity"];
        var ShipToCountry = workflowObject["ShipToCountry"];
        var ShipToName = workflowObject["ShipToName"];
        var ShipToPhone = workflowObject["ShipToPhone"];
        var ShipToState = workflowObject["ShipToState"];
        var ShipToStreet = workflowObject["ShipToStreet"];
        var ShipToZipCode = workflowObject["ShipToZipCode"];

        var Signature = workflowObject["TSASignature"];
         

        mylog("TSASignature: " + Signature);
        
    </script>

    <script>
        var mapCode = new Map([
            [1, "G"],
            [2, "H"],
            [3, "I"],
            [4, "J"],
            [5, "K"],
            [6, "L"],
            [7, "M"],
            [8, "N"],
            [9, "O"],
            [10, "P"],
            [11, "Q"],
            [12, "R"],
            [13, "S"],
            [14, "T"],
            [15, "U"],
            [16, "V"],
            [17, "W"],
            [18, "X"],
            [19, "Y"],
            [20, "g"],
            [40, "h"],
            [60, "i"],
            [80, "j"],
            [100, "k"],
            [120, "l"],
            [140, "m"],
            [160, "n"],
            [180, "o"],
            [200, "p"],
            [220, "q"],
            [240, "r"],
            [260, "s"],
            [280, "t"],
            [300, "u"],
            [320, "v"],
            [340, "w"],
            [360, "x"],
            [380, "y"],
            [400, "z"]
        ]);

        var mycode = document.getElementById("tcode");
        var myconsole = document.getElementById("myconsole");
        var myresult = document.getElementById("myresult");

        var prCode = "";

        var blackLimit = 400;
        var widthBytes = 0;
        var totalBytes = 0;

        var fontSize = 22;
        var leftMargin = 20;
        //var labelWidth = 768;
        var labelWidth = 550;
        var lastFontHeight = fontSize;
        var lastPosY = 0;

        var logob64 = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";

        var auxBinaryChar = ['0', '0', '0', '0', '0', '0', '0', '0'];


        function testcode() {
            mylog("SIG: " + Signature);
            getSignature();
            //runSignature(workflowObject);
        }

        function getCurrency(text) {
            return "$" + (typeof text === "number" ? text.toFixed(2) : "");
        }

        function getShortName(el) {
            el = el.substring(5);
            el = el.replace(/&/g, 'and');
            var str;
            if (el.length > 20) {
                el = el.substring(0, 20) + '...';
            }
            return el;
        }

        function toDataUrl(url, callback) {
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.onload = function() {
                var reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onloadend = function() {
                    callback(reader.result);
                }
                reader.readAsDataURL(xhr.response);
            };
            xhr.open('GET', url);
            xhr.responseType = 'blob';
            xhr.send();
        }

        function toDataUrlPromise(url) {
            var promise = new Promise((resolve) => {

                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.onload = function() {
                    var reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onloadend = function() {
                        resolve(reader.result);
                    }
                    reader.readAsDataURL(xhr.response);
                };
                xhr.open('GET', url);
                xhr.responseType = 'blob';
                xhr.send();

            });
            return promise;
        }

        function fourByteBinary(binaryStr) {
            var decimal = parseInt(binaryStr, 2);
            if (decimal > 15) {
                return decimal.toString(16).toUpperCase();
            } else {
                return "0" + decimal.toString(16).toUpperCase();
            }
        }               

        function encodeHexAscii(code) {
            // code = code.split('\n').join('|');

            var maxlinea = parseInt(widthBytes * 2);
            var sbCode = "";
            var sbLinea = "";
            var previousLine = null;
            var counter = 1;
            var aux = code[0];
            var firstChar = false;

            for (var i = 1; i < code.length; i++) {
                if (firstChar) {
                    aux = code[i];
                    firstChar = false;
                    continue;
                }

                if (code[i] == "\n") {
                    if (counter >= maxlinea && aux == '0') {
                        sbLinea += ",";
                    } else if (counter >= maxlinea && aux == 'F') {
                        sbLinea += "!";
                    } else if (counter > 20) {
                        var multi20 = parseInt(counter / 20) * 20;
                        var resto20 = parseInt(counter % 20);
                        sbLinea += mapCode.get(multi20);
                        if (resto20 != 0) {
                            sbLinea += mapCode.get(resto20) + aux;
                        } else {
                            sbLinea += aux;
                        }
                    } else {
                        sbLinea += mapCode.get(counter) + aux;
                        if (mapCode.get(counter) == null) {}
                    }
                    counter = 1;
                    firstChar = true;

                    if (sbLinea == previousLine) {
                        sbCode += ":";
                    } else {
                        sbCode += sbLinea.toString();
                    }
                    previousLine = sbLinea.toString();
                    // sbLinea.setLength(0);
                    sbLinea = "";
                    continue;
                }
                if (aux == code[i]) {
                    counter++;
                } else {

                    if (counter > 20) {
                        var multi20 = parseInt(counter / 20) * 20;
                        var resto20 = parseInt(counter % 20);
                        sbLinea += mapCode.get(multi20);
                        if (resto20 != 0) {
                            sbLinea += mapCode.get(resto20) + aux;
                        } else {
                            sbLinea += aux;
                        }
                    } else {
                        sbLinea += mapCode.get(counter) + aux;
                    }
                    counter = 1;
                    aux = code[i];
                }
            }
            return sbCode;
        }

        function getImageZPL(res, size = 200, breakline = true, posX = (labelWidth - size) / 2, posY = lastPosY) {
            var promise = new Promise((resolve) => {
                var myimg = document.getElementById("myimg");
                myimg.src = res;
                console.log(myimg.src);

                myimg.onerror = function() {
                    var imgObj = {
                        zpl: "",
                        height: 40
                    };
                    resolve(imgObj);
                }

                myimg.onload = function() {

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 1");

                    var imgW = size;
                    myimg.width = imgW;
                    var imgH = myimg.height

                    var imgPosX = posX;

                    var canvas = document.getElementById("mycanv");

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 2");

                    canvas.width = imgW;
                    canvas.height = imgH;
                    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                    ctx.drawImage(myimg, 0, 0, imgW, imgH);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.6)';

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 3");

                    var xw = imgW;
                    var xh = imgH;

                    widthBytes = xw / 8;
                    if (xw % 8 > 0) {
                        widthBytes = parseInt(xw / 8) + 1;
                    } else {
                        widthBytes = xw / 8;
                    }
                    totalBytes = widthBytes * xh;

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 4");
                    
                    var imgd = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, xw, xh);
                    imgd.crossOrigin = "Anonymous";
                    var pix = imgd.data;

                    var row = 0;
                    var index = 0;
                    var sb = "";
                    var ab = "";

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 5");

                    var idx = 0;

                    for (var h = 0; h < xh; h++) {
                        for (var w = 0; w < xw; w++) {

                            var red = pix[idx];
                            var green = pix[idx + 1];
                            var blue = pix[idx + 2];
                            var alpha = pix[idx + 3];
                            idx += 4;

                            var auxChar = '1';
                            var totalColor = red + green + blue;

                            if (totalColor > blackLimit) {
                                auxChar = '0';
                            }

                            auxBinaryChar[index] = auxChar;

                            index++;
                            if (index == 8 || w == (xw - 1)) {
                                ab += auxBinaryChar.join('');
                                var fbb = fourByteBinary(auxBinaryChar.join(''));
                                sb += fbb;
                                auxBinaryChar = ['0', '0', '0', '0', '0', '0', '0', '0'];
                                index = 0;
                            }
                        }
                        sb += "\n";
                        ab += "\n";
                    }

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 6");

                    var body = encodeHexAscii(sb);

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 7");

                    // var imgZpl = "^FO" + imgPosX + "," + posY + "^GFA,"+ totalBytes + "," + totalBytes + "," + widthBytes +", "
                    // imgZpl += body + "^FS";

                    var imgZpl = "^GFA," + totalBytes + "," + totalBytes + "," + widthBytes + ", "
                    imgZpl += body;

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 8");

                    // if(breakline) {
                    // 	nextLine(xh);
                    // }

                    var imgObj = {
                        zpl: imgZpl,
                        height: xh
                    };

                    mylog(">>> ZPL: 9");

                    resolve(imgObj);
                }
            });
            return promise;
        }

        function runSignature(y) {
            mylog("2 - call runSignature");
            console.log(JSON.stringify(y, undefined, 2));
            var base64Sig = "";
            if (y.object.URI != "") {
                base64Sig = y.object.URI;
                workflowObject["TSASignature"] = base64Sig;
                console.log(base64Sig);
            } else {
                base64Sig;
            }
            prCode = "";
            nextLine(30);
            prCode += changeFont("0", fontSize) + "\n";

            var logo = null;
            getImageZPL(logob64, 300, false, 0).then((logoObj) => {
                mylog("- return from getImageZPL - logo");
                logo = logoObj;
                return getImageZPL(base64Sig, 400);
            }).then((sig) => {
                mylog("- return from getImageZPL - signature");

                var logoZpl = "^FO" + leftMargin + "," + 45 + logo.zpl + "^FS";
                prCode += logoZpl + "\n";

                mylog(">>> 1");
                nextLine(140);
                mylog(">>> 2");
                prCode += printBold("General Information") + "\n";
                prCode += printLine() + "\n";
                //prCode += printText("Credit # " + GeneratedInvoiceID) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Account Name" + AccountName) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Account External ID " + AccountExternalID) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("ID            " + WrntyID) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Date + Time: " + ActionDateTime) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Sales Rep   " + AgentName) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Currency    " + Currency) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("") + "\n";

                prCode += printBold("Account Information") + "\n";
                prCode += printLine() + "\n";
                mylog(">>> 3");
                prCode += printText("Bill to Name:    " + BillToName) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Bill to Address: " + BillToStreet) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("                    " + BillToCity) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("                    " + BillToState) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("                    " + BillToZipCode) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("                    " + BillToCountry) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Bill to Phone:   " + BillToPhone) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("") + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Ship to Name:   " + ShipToName) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Ship to Address:" + ShipToStreet) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("                    " + ShipToCity) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("                    " + ShipToState) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("                    " + ShipToZipCode) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("                    " + ShipToCountry) + "\n";
                prCode += printText("Ship to Phone:  " + ShipToPhone) + "\n";

                nextLine(10);
                prCode += printBold("Items") + "\n";
                prCode += printLine() + "\n";

                mylog(">>> 5");
                if (workflowObject.TransactionLines && workflowObject.TransactionLines.length > 0) {

                    var lines = workflowObject.TransactionLines;
                    var table = [
                        ["Item Code", "Description", "Price", "Quant"]
                    ];
                    lines.forEach(elem => {
                        if (elem) {
                            table.push([elem.ItemCode, elem.ItemName,getCurrency(elem.UnitPrice), elem.ItemCaseQuantity]);
                        }
                    });
                    prCode += printTable(table, [0.75, 2, 0.5, 0.5], ["L", "L", "L", "L"]);
                }

                mylog(">>> 6");
                nextLine(10);
                prCode += printLine() + "\n";
                prCode += printTable([
                    ["Totals ", getCurrency(GrandTotal)]
                ], [3, 5], ["L", "L"]);
                prCode += printLine() + "\n";


                nextLine(10);
                prCode += printBold("Signature") + "\n";

                mylog(">>> 7");
                var sigZpl = "^FO" + (labelWidth - 400) / 2 + "," + lastPosY + sig.zpl + "^FS";
                prCode += sigZpl + "\n";
                nextLine(sig.height);
                prCode += printLine() + "\n";

                mylog(">>> 8");
                // COMPLETE ZPL CODE
                var fullcode = headDoc(lastPosY) + prCode + footDoc();
                mycode.value = fullcode;

                mylog(">>> 9");
                prCode += printText("Order Note " + Remark) + "\n";
                nextLine(10);
                
              sendToPrinter(fullcode);
              
            });
        }
        
        function getSignature() {
            console.log(Signature);
            console.log(workflowObject);
            if (workflowObject.TSASignature == "") {
                runSignature({
                    object: {
                        URI: Signature
                    }
                });
            } else {
                mylog("1 - call getSignature");
                pepperi.api.attachments.get({
                    key: {
                        UUID: Signature
                    },
                    fields: ['URL', 'URI'],
                    responseCallback: 'runSignature'
                });
            }
            
        }


        function sendToPrinter(toprint) {
            mylog("3 - call sendToPrinter");
            console.log(toprint);
            var encodedString = window.btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(toprint)));
            var string2print = 'nnbluetoothprint://?LabelData=' + encodedString +
                '&LabelDataType=ZPLBase64&SourceUrl=PepperiApp://';
            var string2printfinal = {
                url: string2print,
                options: {}
            };

            onOpenExternalRequest(string2printfinal);
            onSaveAndClose();
        }

        function mylog(text) {
            console.log(text);
            myconsole.value += text + "\n";
        }

        // ================ ZEBRA FUNCTIONS

        function headDoc(len = 1000) {
            var str = "^XA^LL" + len + "\n";
            return str;
        }

        function footDoc() {
            var str = "\n^XZ";
            return str;
        }

        function changeFont(font, height) {
            lastFontHeight = height;
            return "^CF" + font + "," + height;
        }

        function printText(text, breakline = true, x = leftMargin, y = lastPosY, z = 0) {
            var str = "^FO" + x + "," + y + "," + z;
            str += "^FD" + text;
            str += "^FS";
            if (breakline) {
                nextLine();
            }
            return str;
        }

        function printBarcode(text, breakline = true, x = leftMargin, y = lastPosY, z = 0) {
            var str = "^FO" + 40 + "," + y + "," + z;
            str += "^BY2";
            str += "^BUN,70";
            str += "^FD" + text.replace(/-/g, '');
            str += "^FS";
            if (breakline) {
                nextLine(100);
            }
            return str;
        }

        function printBold(text, x = leftMargin, y = lastPosY) {
            var str = printText(text, false, x + 1);
            str += printText(text, true, x);
            return str;
        }

        function printBlock(text, justif = "L", breakline = true, x = leftMargin, y = lastPosY, w = labelWidth -
            leftMargin, b = 1, c = 0) {
            var str = "^FO" + x + "," + y;
            str += "^FB" + w + "," + b + "," + c + "," + justif;
            str += "^FD" + text;
            str += "^FS";
            if (breakline) {
                nextLine(b * lastFontHeight);
            }
            return str;
        }

        function printLine(w = labelWidth - leftMargin, x = leftMargin, y = lastPosY) {
            var str = "^FO" + x + "," + (y + 2) + "^GB" + w + ",0,2^FS";
            nextLine(8);
            return str;
        }

        function printTable(table, sizes = null, alignment = null) {
            var str = "";

            var size = table[0].length;
            var gap = parseInt(labelWidth / size);

            var sizesSum = null;
            if (sizes) {
                sizesSum = sizes.reduce((acc, val) => acc + val);
                gap = parseInt(labelWidth / sizesSum);
            }

            table.forEach(elem => {
                if (elem) {
                    var row = elem;
                    var auxGap = gap;
                    var gapSum = leftMargin;

                    row.forEach((cell, idx) => {
                        if (sizes) {
                            auxGap = sizes[idx] * gap;
                        }

                        var align = "C";
                        if (alignment && alignment.length === size) {
                            align = alignment[idx];
                        }

                        str += printBlock(cell, align, false, gapSum, undefined, auxGap);
                        gapSum += auxGap;
                    });
                    str += "\n";
                    nextLine();
                }
            });
            return str;
        }

        function nextLine(gap = lastFontHeight) {
            lastPosY += gap;
        }
    </script>
    <script>
        testcode();
    </script>
</body>

</html>
